book.name: Luka
book.title: Orooka o lebo ka Luka wele

content: O era o Yeso a malo o gbwǝ
A lelere aping o lengme le o bora,
na andaye me ale ocau me ka magogoro ma owaze o lebo kane babare wai.
Nane mana a kinkǝri ocale ome a waya bengmǝ bo ocau me,
Nangka ne lyǝ a nyimi me, nane ta mana lepung le Yeso Ateokora ne.
Nangka neya madoola aza nyimi, a saseya na andaleme leere suri ating one, aane amba madibi ma o wonza a yizi.
A nyimi boome na andaye me tunggunǝ tokpwe tone a deze, na aromo me bekaa ne na, “Eyaka eya gera ondo ebeene a nyimi andaaka ne gbwizǝ?
Kata arakana ne, ka era. Rintǝna epa eka ka bekaa ying a makeke ma Galili,
‘O sara ta zene ne a yo nya Kena ka Oromo a taara te aromo madinǝ kane wong kai azaa uti o gendare, a lengme lo taaro aka ere.’ ”
Na andaye me ne rintǝ angmǝ Yeso.
Nangka ne kuri aane suri ocau me, nane bekaa pate a atoma a Yeso betuuru ka o yende name, ko dangare aromo pate epa name.
Ana Mariya ka mea beya kai na Magadala, ka Yowana, a Mariya iini Yakubu, ka o dangare andaye, nane bele atoma kai epa eka eze.
Na atoma Yeso ta kabare epa eka andaye name ne bele ne ne, o bena angmǝ ane a ta orona ne.

Na Biturusu ere ba wup ka tesong a wa ale o ocau me. Ko dukǝ a wa tunggunu, a wa gokareke nyimi ocau me, na wa laka betu beeka a pate kai ne à á eke a sara yende. Na wa kuri akwilǝ ka madoola ma epa eka eya ale.
Ana o tare Yeso a leere orona Imawus
A lengme lenname, ana o tare a Yeso anda leere neya teweno to ale a kapeng ka yende ka beya kai na Imawus, kamea kata ewa maleo ne ka apeng Urushalima.
Neya dano aza epa eka eya ale.
Aneya za o dano naname, na Yeso okpwe kai paka ne aka lya izi ko yenga ka ne.
A Ashili a pate ne o rosa kai.
Naka bekaa ne na, “Eya dano aza eya a nyimi teweno tane?” Nane itǝ ara yende aane caro a mainu.
Na ondo a nyimi one ka a beya wai na Kiliyabas wa pirkǝ kai na, “Boa ayende ogeng a apeng Urushalima ko ta rosa epa eka eya ale a tomore teena ne na?”

Naka pirkǝ ne na, “Eya ya ale?” Na ne bekaana, “Epa eka e mana Yeso ko Nazarat. Kai kando ka o beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili, angmǝ akai aye ka legoone, a magole ma kai a begeshe ba Ashili ka aromo ma moole.
Kanza ana magame ma Ashili ma moole ka andaano a makeke ne core ngmǝ o wong kai aane gendare kai uti.
Ro tese eke a lenyong o bekaana, kaya kayo boza maYahuda ka pere ne. Eya kang tata, wa amara ka tomore te taaro naana aza epaana eya ale.
Bangka nyimi andaye yende a nyimi aro ne nya ro epa e mole, ne ale o ocau me a leleere aping,
pate ka nyimi neta ne mana lepung le kai ne. Nane de aane bekaa ro na ne laka Atoma Ashili o zaa shili nane bekaa ne na ebeene e kuri a kai kanza.
Na ana ondo a nyimi aro, ne ale o ocau me nane mana nangka andaye me ne beka, aane ta laka lepung le Yeso me ne.”
Na Yeso bekaa ne na, “Ying a rara, andaaka anyong ane ta rosaza eyapa a saseya ka ne kabare pate epa eka ana o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili ne wela angmǝ Ashili ne.
A samba o bekaame na Ondooka Ashili a zake kayo zitǝ a marona cake, malo nyimi aka lyǝ ara o kona o leba kai a rere.”
Naka baale ne pate epa eka Mosa ka ana o beya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili ne wele aza Ondooka Ashili a zake.
Nangka ne amara ka kapeng ka yende kamea neya ale ne, na Yeso kaye na kaya lya izi ka teweno.
Nane paka kai ane nyitǝmǝrǝnu a bose kai na, “Cikǝ ka ro, o lyǝlu waya, a were o taru ongme waya.” Naka tare ne aka cikǝ ka ne.
Nangka ne cikǝ aro lya epaolya, naka jeke o borode, aka kone o leba Ashili, aka poseze naka areseze ne.
A arakanamea a Ashili a pari ne o rosa kai, a malo nyimi naka wili ane.
Nane bekaa tokpwe tone na, “Eyaka anyong aro a ta a pǝrnu ka te rose ko kona o leba a were aka kaya beya ngmǝ ka ro orona, aka ya baala aro angmǝ Ashili ne?”
A were name ne ere nane kuri apeng a Urushalima nane mana atoma betuuru ko yende ko dangare ana o tare o kai,
a neya beya na, “Nyimi waze, Ateokora ka era aka wore okpwe kai ara Siman Biturusu.”
Na aromo leere name ne baale pate epa eka e mane ne orona, ka nangka ne rose kai a were aka ka arseze ne o borode.
Ogole oka Yeso ka nya ana o tare okai
A neya za o beya ngmǝ aza nyimi, na Yeso okpwe kai ka itǝ a tera one aka beye ne oko na, “O cikǝ a cammo tare ka ying.”
Na boome moke ne anyong ane kerkeze, aza o bekaana ne laka bebuu.
Naka bekaa ne na, “Eyaka eya kona boome nanna? Eyaka eta e kabare ka Ashili anyong aying ne?
Solekena manyuwǝ a taara ka tobona tong. Mea kai ko okpwe ong. Mekenna ka e kone, bebuu ta ya ka enama ka cako ne, nangka me ang zene.”
Nangka ka beke nyimi, aka wore ne taara te kai ka tobona tome.
Ne tata ko dera o kabare anyong o bekaana neya kona o leba ka epa e moole, naka pirkǝ ne na, “Eya ka epaolya ara kaana na?”
Nane nya kai bekwala bemea a eesa,
Naka embe be aka lye, aneya gonta kai.
Naka bekaa ne na, “Epa ena ma bekaa ying a were aka ma tata ka ying: Eyo pena nangka a wele aza ong a nyimi ngmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa, ka ana o beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili, ka Seleera.”
Naka pari madoola mane, nane rose angmǝ Ashili ka a wele.
Kanza aka bekaa ne na, “Epa ena a wela, na Ondooka Ashili a zake kayo zitǝ ka wong kai aka ere a nyimi o ocau a lengme lo taaro,
kanza oroka o kurǝ a Ashili
Ka o kwizǝ madinǝ waya a yo beya a nyimi leze le kai a pate lerambo le Ashili a bore apeng Urushalima.
Yingnga andaaka e laka ka eyo baala ana ondo.
Eyang tonga o ying ka epa eka Ate wa beka. Cikǝ na a nyimi apeng zongka ang nya ying legoone le obere o rere o suri aza shili.”
Yeso ka zale zaa shili
Naka sǝǝrǝ ne a malo peng Urushalima, a kulu kapeng ka Betanya, aramea ka ara taara to kai aza shili aka kare ne o kona o leba.
Malo o kare one o leba, naka arnang ka ne, a ana kai a ale azaa shili.
Nane tunggunu ane nya kai togomo to kai, ane kuri apeng Urushalima ko kona o leba o cake.
Nane cikǝ akwilǝ Ashili koonang lengme, ane saba Ai.

Kapeng kame a ale a Urushalima kata kala teweno ta were taaro ne.
“O kurǝ Ashili,” waya o kabare ka Ashili a oromo wa arnang ka madinǝ ma wai.
